mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 6% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 6%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing HOUST and RSAFS signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when both HOUST and RSAFS increase (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO above its 6-month moving average indicates improving supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced costs and increased productivity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO > 6mo MA, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 0.5%) and high CPIAUCSL (> 250) signals an impending monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in PAYEMS indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with sustained PAYEMS growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of decreasing UNRATE and increasing RSAFS signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher retail sales.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.12).
